title: News desk daily
summary: Tighten one take on one story into a short news video.
description: Start from a recording of yourself telling one story. The agent cuts the stalls and retakes, keeps the facts in order, puts each source on screen as a lower third and captions every word.
brief: This is my take on {{story}}. Tighten it into a short news video for {{audience}}. The sources I used: {{sources}}.

fields.label: story
fields.hint: The one story the take is about

fields.label: sources
fields.hint: Where the facts came from; write "none" if you didn't use any
fields.example: the council's press release and the budget document
